snippet.title: The Forbidden Tomes of Olipos - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
What started as an out-of-town gig quickly turns into the journey of a lifetime for Romina! The young librarian will hunt forbidden tomes, fight powerful foes, and discover ancient mysteries in this classic JRPG adventure. What truth awaits at the end of it all?
